description: This file defines the Vtiger_Block class, which provides methods and data structures for managing CRM module blocks within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving block instances, along with handling associated fields.

classes.name: Vtiger_Block
classes.description: Represents a CRM module block, provides API to manage blocks such as creation, deletion, update, and retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing a Vtiger_Block instance.

methods.name: __getUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves a unique block ID from the database.

methods.name: __getNextSequence
methods.description: Retrieves the next sequence number for block ordering within the module.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the block instance with provided values and associates it with a module.

methods.name: __create
methods.description: Creates a new block record in the database.

methods.name: __update
methods.description: Updates an existing block record in the database.

methods.name: __delete
methods.description: Deletes the block record from the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the block, creating or updating as necessary.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes this block, optionally including associated fields.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a field to this block.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages for debugging or informational purposes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of a block by ID or label.

methods.name: getAllForModule
methods.description: Retrieves all blocks for a specific module.

methods.name: deleteForModule
methods.description: Deletes all blocks associated with a module, optionally deleting related fields.
